name: axon-mcp
description: SkySpark Axon from the Axon MCP server: examples, patterns, docs, call graph, semantic search, Haystack queries, and running and committing Axon in the active SkySpark project. Workflow guides ship as skills.

mcp_url.title: Axon MCP endpoint
mcp_url.description: Streamable HTTP MCP URL. Default goes through the local mcp-proxy on :9191 so the connector stays up while the server restarts.
